subject: PVC Millwork in Historic Preservation
overview: The Historic District Commission heard an educational presentation on the use of PVC millwork in historic preservation, discussed ongoing recruitment efforts to fill board vacancies, and approved past meeting minutes.

items.title: Presentation on PVC Millwork Applications
items.summary: Tyler from Intex Millwork Solutions presented on the performance, milling, painting requirements, and structural reinforcement of cellular PVC products used in historic architectural replications.

items.title: Board Recruitment Efforts
items.summary: The commission discussed outreach strategies to fill two vacant seats, including tabling at community festivals, hosting a city board open house, and directing applicants to the city website.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted to accept the meeting minutes from July 9.

items.title: Future Business and Historic District Planning
items.summary: Members confirmed the November meeting date and agreed to add an overview of the process for designating new local historic districts to the next agenda.
